notes.title: New Featured Levels: Tech Wave 1
notes.content:
[h2]Version 2.9.2[/h2]

As of recently, it's been six years since we first launched A Dance of Fire and Ice on Steam!

Over that time, we've received a tidal wave of support way beyond anything we could have predicted. Thank you to everyone who has played, left reviews, told their friends, and made videos about ADOFAI. Thanks to your continued interest, we've been able to spend all these years working on updates and improvements. Brick by brick, we've expanded the game into something much bigger than we had imagined in 2019.

One of those bricks has been the addition of Featured Levels. With Featured Levels, we're able to work directly with talented creators from the community to license their levels officially and put them into the main game. Up until this point, we've been adding "Classic-style" Featured Levels, which are levels that largely follow the mechanics and design ideas that we explored ourselves in ADOFAI.

Today, the first wave of Tech Levels is here!

Tech Levels are a different style of ADOFAI level. They follow new charting conventions, many of which were popularized by the custom chart community after we released our Level Editor. Sometimes, Tech Levels are more difficult than Classic Levels. Sometimes, they just ask for you to be ready for different shapes, rhythms, and tempos than you might be used to. Either way, you'll probably want to utilize more fingers on the keyboard while playing. For detailed explanation, please visit our [url=https://7thbeat.notion.site/Difficulty-Classic-Tech-18f90365a16180659f67f494cb35abce]knowledge base[/url].

Because so many people in the community love making, and playing, these Tech Levels…we wanted to bring a few into the game for everyone to try!

[h2]Changes and Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] New design of the Pause Menu: We've re-designed our Pause Menu to coincide with our continued development on the Nintendo Switch version of the game. The menu should be a smoother experience now, and better suited to controller compatibility.
[*] Sightreading Warnings: We've added warning tags to a few Featured Levels. These tags indicate the level was used in a community Sightreading Tournament. Because of that, they're quite hard to complete without missing, and are intended to be a test of high score. We've enabled No-Fail Mode for these levels, only for the first time you play them. See how well you do!
[*] We've fixed issues with the game running on Steam Deck
[*] We've disabled Asynchronous Input as a choice in the settings if you're using the Linux (or Steam Deck) version of the game. It was causing some bugs on Linux that we are still looking into.
[*] Minor bugfixes
[/list]
[h2]New Featured Levels[/h2]
[h3]Tech Wave 1 / v2.9.2[/h3]

In addition to the levels themselves, we're introducing a new "radar system" exclusively for Featured Tech Levels! This radar will identify the strength in level's stamina, speed, rhythm, and tech! Check it out in the new Featured Tech section in the CLS!

Please note that the gem difficulty of these levels are temporary / not final. We will be working the gem difficulty system in the future to allow for harder levels.

[b]Backyard Sanctuary[/b]
Music by Tanger
Level by CausticLime

"This level, by CausticLime, is a chill, easy pseudo-focused tech level, suggested by various players for learning the basics of alternating with pseudos. Learning takes time, and mastery takes even longer, so relax, take your time, and let the power of practice do the work for you."

[b]Turkish March[/b]
Music by W. A. Mozart (arranged by Misoguy)
Level by Misoguy

"A musical composition so old only some people of today know about it, Turkish March, has arrived in ADOFAI! This level, created by Misoguy, contains fast-paced patterns and magic shapes! Let your inner pianist flow through your hands as you march on!"

[b]Feral [Hard] & [Insane][/b]
Music by meganeko
Level by Ma6icCu8e

With the introduction of Featured Tech Levels, two new difficulties have arrived!

"meganeko returns with a 5-minute epic! Instead of one level, Ma6icCu8e has made different levels to suit all difficulties. They are all so interesting and varied that we wanted to feature all of them, for players of all skill levels. Hard difficulty is for players who beat It Go and need extra challenge, introducing pseudo-multitaps and key rolling to the mix, while Insane difficulty is for highly skilled players, featuring faster and more complex patterns involving pseudo-multitaps and key rolling."

[b]R[/b]
Music by Plum
Level by KanoKaz & NumbEr07

"This is one of the most famous ADOFAI custom levels, with music by Plum, a very popular artist in the ADOFAI community. A 2020 collaboration between NumbEr07 and KanoKaz, this level uses Magic Shapes - the use of snails and rabbits to make kaleidoscope-like shapes with the track, while the players simply tap out a stream of consistent notes."

[b]deleted[/b]
Music by linear ring
Level by Nephrolepis & ChyaRyam

This level has been completely remade in commemoration of its debut in the Featured Levels list!

"Through Nephrolepis and ChyaRyam's team effort, linear ring's unique electronic sound has been brought to life in ADOFAI! Complex patterns in high BPMs await in your pursuit of escape before the world gets deleted."

[b]felys -final remix-[/b]
Music by onoken
Level by Editor AlriC

"felys is a 2002 classic that influenced and popularized Artcore, a mix of Drum & Bass and classical/traditional music. The song's lovely and graceful sound touched the hearts of listeners, particularly musicians who were inspired by onoken's music to produce their own Artcore music. Editor AlriC's elegant taste in VFX and charting allows us to experience its beauty visually in ADOFAI!"

Here's a new preview video showcasing this wave of Featured Levels: 

[previewyoutube=vkElkzProIs;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]New 7BG Team Member[/h2]
Together with this update, we're also happy to announce our new team member! SaJabe has joined 7BG as our [b]Tech Levels Lead[/b]! He will be curating and creating Tech levels for the game. This first batch of Tech featured levels is his first contribution. Please give him a warm welcome!

As always, thanks for playing!

[h2]Version 2.9.0[/h2]

[h3]A Dance of Fire and Ice Coming to Nintendo Switch[/h3]

As you might remember, we're bringing A Dance of Fire and Ice to the Nintendo Switch! We were so happy to be included in one of 2024's Indie World presentations. Although we've been making great progress on the port, we will unfortunately need to push the expected release date into 2025. 

As always, we're taking things at our own pace to focus on making something new and special for the Nintendo Switch version that we think you'll really enjoy!

We'll have more information on what new content you can expect next year when we're ready to show it off.

[h3]Level Editor Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Hitbox Target Planet option (including options for "Any", "Center Planet" or "Orbiting PLanet"). This is useful for triggering events when stepping on a Freeroam floor
[*] You can now use 1x1 Freeroam sections without text-editing
[*] Editor panel is now resizable
[*] Set Input Event, for detecting particular keyboard inputs. It can detect the keyboard's left half or right half, or detect arrow keys. Allows for keydown and keyup options, or can ignore player input and use keys only for events.
[/list]
[h2]New Featured Levels[/h2]
[h3]Wave 10 (v2.9.0)[/h3]

[b]3000 Moons[/b]
Music: Zris
Level: Bingsu
Round like the moon, 3000 Moons is a dotted eighth-focused level for fans of octagon rhythms like those from World 10! Charming like the moon, it has a cool midnight atmosphere that matches the song's vibe, resembling that YOUtopia you've been looking for.

[b]Disk Failure[/b]
Music: Sunnexo
Level: M1n3c4rt & CyanAqua
A hard disk drive has malfunctioned! Its memories are being corrupted! Escape from these twisty turns and trials orchestrated by these two viruses, codenamed "M1n3c4rt" and "CyanAqua," that together will ruin your day!

[b]Sonder[/b]
Music: Shirobon
Level: Bin, Vybbles, Rikri, TeoC
"How much can you do with music that has very repetitive rhythm?" is the question these four creators were able to answer through this level. It received positive reception for its uniqueness in gameplay but imprisoned those who dared to conquer it. Take a deep breath, and lock in.

[b]VANGUARD-1[/b]
Music: II-L
Level: yeetyote, kernby, Econ, Cam_
VANGUARD-1 is the oldest satellite still orbiting the Earth. As the planets align with its orbit, you are given the chance to take a peek at the aged artifact's journey around the cosmos. Filled to the brim with tricky rhythms and visual obstructions, you struggle to see a clear route. Will you manage to stay on course and see the trip to its end? Or will you become lost in space?


Here's a preview video showcasing the 10th wave of Featured Levels!

[previewyoutube=BGr1VdcsSic;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Updates to Past Featured Levels[/h3]

[b]LORELEI[/b]
We've replaced jacket/portal art with a high-quality version (courtesy of Ssimille).

We're almost done with work for the year before taking a little bit of a holiday break. We'll let you know if we have any more small updates before 2024 is over. Thank you for all your support this year, especially with our waves of Featured Levels! It's been incredible to see what people have been able to make in our Editor lately.

As always, thanks for playing!

notes.title: New Xtra World: Party of Spirits!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34150082/375aa689abb97e40e5811a5bae60f756c695bebd.png[/img]

[h2]Version 2.8.0[/h2]

[h3]New Xtra World: XS-X Party of Spirits[/h3]
Music by: Cansol
Tutorial Music by: Blooky
Level by: NumbEr07
VFX by: Firestix

Let's party! This was a really fun world to make. We knew we wanted to work with this piece for a long time, especially with how quick and bouncy it is. It was a perfect opportunity to introduce a new character, our Tiger. Firestix went the extra mile on animating all of our ideas, and we love how it came out. Enjoy!

[h3]New Featured Levels[/h3]
[b]Olie - Temple Of Treasure [by TeoC][/b]
Temple Of Treasure is one of the 5 episodes of Everypence, a story written by Olie. TeoC loved Olie's story so much he decided to adapt it to ADOFAI. We were impressed by how he created this adaptation, especially by making original gameplay gimmicks inspired by it. Temple Of Treasure stands out as our favorite because of its interesting gimmick that makes you switch between 2 pairs of planets that are different in speed. Pro tip: be mindful of the audio cues; they will help you during the switch-ups!

[b]Raimukun - Avantgarde [by Team Vega][/b]
Team Vega's return to making more high-quality levels couldn't be grander when they published Avantgarde, a level that won the 'Art-est Award' in LOTY2023 for its outstanding VFX made by talented creators around the world! This level is also one of the toughest featured levels, with an average BPM so fast that the rhythms you may be already familiar with were taken to the extreme!

[b]Lokan - Wild! West! Showdown! [by Star4th][/b]
Wild! West! Showdown! is a track made for PABAT! 2019, with an animation that tells the story of a duel between two foes for one treasure. Star4th adapted this to ADOFAI for the SMTL competition, where he was given a penalty that states: "The level must exactly have 48 twirls." Wondering where those twirls went should be the least of your worries though, because... Wait, huh? THE LAST TILE IS SENTIENT???

[b]Camellia vs Akira Complex - Railgun Roulette (VIP) [by Econ, Twilight Skylines, ABorinGuy, yeetyote][/b]
Railgun Roulette (VIP) is a track made by a collaboration between Camellia and Akira Complex with their powerful head-banging take on Drum & Bass music! This level was made for FAINT, a fan-run sightreading tournament where players compete in levels they have never seen before! This level may look easy, but don't sleep on those visual distractions, they might catch you off guard!

Thank you, Akira Complex. We miss you. 

(Note: This track may be flagged by fingerprint systems such as YouTube Content ID.)

[h3]Plus...One Updated Featured Level[/h3]

The first 7 gem Featured Level have been given a new makeover from Daming!

[/list]

[h3]Level Editor Additions, Fixes, and Improvements[/h3]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34150082/6a215a63982e226cb9408494ca11b5a03452c327.png[/img]

It's the 5-Year Anniversary of A Dance of Fire and Ice! 

Thank you so much for playing our game all these years. It's been amazing to watch how the custom level community has gotten better and better over time. The levels that the community has made are so creative, and the skills on display by the streamers who play them have been really impressive. We're a really small team, so we never imagined that people would still be playing after all this time.

We hope you continue to enjoy the game! To celebrate, we've added one new Xtra World and a set of new Featured Levels.

[h2]Version 2.7.0[/h2]

[h3]New Xtra World: Miko Skip[/h3]
World XM: Miko Skip
Music by Kirara Magic
Level Design by Astral Overseer and KanoKaz
Level VFX by Editor AlriC and KanoKaz
Special Thanks to lifliif

A short, relaxing world for players of all skill levels. You can find it on Xtra Island!

[h3]New Featured Levels[/h3]

[b]Overnote' - Amulet [/b]
Level by FluffyYoshi & Nickname
FluffyYoshi, known for their tough stamina-testing charts, and Nickname, known for their contributions in some of the popular custom levels today, have come together to create a beautiful but challenging level that tests players in their mechanical skill and stamina. Prepare for a speedy challenge!

[b]Ssimille - Surreal Walk[/b]
Level by Bingsu
Level creators can be Artists too! This is demonstrated by the well-respected Ssimille, composing one of his tracks, Surreal Walk! Level by HanB
A throwback to 2020, when the creators you may have known today start in their humble beginnings. HanB is one of them, as they create yet another fun, electrifying level, with sudden changes of its pace! Enjoy, but be sure to pay attention!

[b]Riya - Artificial Chariot (Ssimille Remix)[/b]
Level by hotduck, Hanwol, Bingsu
A perfect ending to one of Team Vega's biggest projects. We were astonished by the impressive gameplay and visuals of the level, especially paired with Ssimille's beautiful remix of Riya's 'Artificial Chariot' from World 12.

[b]iTIC - Triple Sec [/b]
Level by Pharah & hyonsu
Pharah is celebrated for being one of, if not, the most talented and skilled VFXers in the ADOFAI community for creating levels that are as if he's using a video editing software! [b]Monokuro - Black Rose[/b]
Level by CyanAqua

CyanAqua, and his dedication to making gameplay gimmicks that are fun to play for everyone, were able to win the 'Gimmick Award' in LOTY2023 through Black Rose! It is an RPG Maker-inspired level with a gimmick that is easy to understand, but gets trippy once distractions start to appear!

[/list]

[list]
[*] Game should support many more tiles on a single level. In our testing, a level with 86,000 tiles used to run at 26 FPS, after optimization it now runs at 128 FPS.

[list]
[*]The Scale fields from the [b]Move Decoration[/b] and [b]Move Track[/b] events can be now left empty to not change one or both of their axis values.

[h2]Version 2.6.0[/h2]

[h3]New Team Members:[/h3]
We've added a few new members to the 7th Beat Games team!

Hyonsu and Paring are two programmers who have come aboard to help us with all sorts of ADOFAI features, especially for the level editor. They work fast and have been incredibly helpful members of the team for the past few months.

Rikri and rKizCora have also joined us! rKizCora is helping us with Featured Level selection and Rikri is helping us with licensing and communication with level creators. Having them assist us is crucial to us being able to add more Featured Levels, so we super appreciate it. It's a lot of things to manage at once while developing a game!

On a related note, our team member Nichipe has stepped away from an active role in helping us with Featured Levels, due to a busy schedule. Rikri and rKizCora have joined to help us in Nichipe's absence, so please don't send Nichipe any questions or messages regarding Featured Levels! 

[h3]New Featured Levels:[/h3]

[b]Fog sees it[/b]
"Fog sees it is a great example of a level where everything is made by the same creator, which is something you don't usually see nowadays and is highly commendable for doing so!"

We've actually included two different versions of the level. Those are…

Plant Guy - Fog sees it
Level by: Plant Guy
"This level features a gameplay gimmick to keep your eyes peeled for, as the only thing that will guide you in this journey are the sign tiles. Follow the directions, and never lose your sight!"

Plant Guy - Fog sees it (Metal Powered)
Level by; Plant Guy
"This is the "metal-powered" version of Fog sees it. Unlike its original, this level features faster speeds and intense visuals. Use the sign tiles as your advantage to visualize the challenging hidden pathways, but act fast or one small trip can send you to the void!"
(Note: It is highly recommended to play the regular "Fog sees it" first.)

[b]Othinus - Fragor Magnus[/b]
Level by: Hawkyrious and TeoC
"Recall the wonderful voyage you've gone through in this equally wonderful level made by Hawkyrious with rock-n-roll tunes by Othinus! It uses the concept of remixing all of ADOFAI Worlds 1-12 into one memorable level. This level has been given a visual remake by TeoC and a song rearrangement by Erichey to give the level a more refined sound and look. 
(Cutscene music courtesy of 0mni)

[b]Kubbi & Jonas Dam - Up In My Jam (All Of A Sudden)[/b]

"This level won 1st place in Rhythm Doctor Lounge's ADOFAI Community Competition 1: Steampunk! With great chiptune + rock music made by Kubbi & Jonas Dam and brilliant decorations and storytelling done by Kin, this level feels like a crossover of a cartoon show! It perfectly gives you the experience of taking a tour around a place you've never been before, filling you with excitement and curiosity while you gaze at peculiar but glamorous works of art."

[b]Inverted Silence - Vista[/b]
Level by: Econ and Yeetyote
Vista is the end product of mixing Econ's great taste in charting, YeetYote's beautifully explosive VFX, and Inverted Silence's head-banging glitch-hop sounds! Wild rumors say that during this journey, your vision may be distracted and the sense of time may be frozen, but once you reach the top, your eyes will surely be fed well with a beautiful view!

(Some assets courtesy of kernby)
(Note: This track may be flagged by fingerprint systems such as YouTube Content ID.)

[b]Jade Kim - Love Letters (KOTDARI Remix)[/b]
Level by: FluffyYoshi, yhld120, pixelo3o
"This level won 2nd place for the "Best Relaxing Level Award" in LOTY 2022! Also known as "4-EX" and hosted by Team Vega, it took a different perspective of what World 4-X would look like if the theme was something else. FluffyYoshi, yhld120, pixelo3o, and KOTDARI thought it would be a cool idea to turn World 4-X into a modernistic-designed level with chill but energetic glitch-hop music. Turns out, that was a perfect match!"

[h3]Level Editor[/h3]
Object Decoration: A new type of decoration! You can now add "fake" floor tiles and "fake" planets to your level.

New Level Setting: "Speed Trial Aim", now you can set a goal speed for players playing a Speed Trial of your custom level!

New "Level Editor Preferences" menu within the Editor.

Zooming is centered for mouse position. You can revert to the old behavior using the Level Editor Preferences menu.

Enabled Level Editor in Steam Deck!

You can move your camera freely without dragging any decorations or tiles by dragging when mouse middle button is held

Locked decorations will not be selected anymore.

Changed ToggleBool to Bool. This means previously "Enabled" and "Disabled" text in .adofai file will be now saved as true and false

Improved Repeat Event

https://youtu.be/ynl21Fmp8DY

Decoration Hitbox Event Tag Trigger 
Example video: 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=h6b9lya8tps

New Setting for Move Decorations Event: Relative to Last Position

[h3]Mobile: Cloud Saves[/h3]
This feature saves your progress automatically in the cloud, so you can keep your progress between different devices or upon reinstalling the game. It requires an internet connection, and is only able to sync on the same platform (from iOS device to iOS device, or from Android device to Android device).

[h3]Mobile: Achievements[/h3]
We've brought the same achievements from the Steam version of the game over to the mobile versions. On iOS, this uses Game Center. On Android, this uses Play Game Services. 

[h3]Mobile: Keyboard Support[/h3]
On iOS, you can now use a wired or wireless keyboard as a controller. This was already available on Android devices.

This update has a whopping [b]7 new levels[/b] in the Featured Levels section, plus some UI + Quality of Life improvements, and new features in the Level Editor!

(Original level created by NexaLi, PLORALD, Hanwol, Asansis, Jo Future and Nephrolepis. While the original level was made to aim for the highest difficulty, this level was recreated to lower the difficulty. This level borrows some visual effects from the original level.)"

(Portal image courtesy of YeetYote)"

Music by: Frums
Level by: Daming
"This level won 2nd place for the "Gimmick Award" in LOTY 2022! Daming's masterful use of filters gives this level a visual style unlike any other! The charting is beautiful and highlights Frums' tricky rhythms! It even has a cool gameplay gimmick to boot! Don't step on the noisy tiles!"

Music by: Frums

"While Frums' characteristic style of music has an unmistakable flavor, they wanted to try something different for Jam with Pancake. What they cooked up is a song with a great jazz-like taste! Paired with Daming's delicious gameplay and great presentation, this level will leave you hungry for more!"

Music by: Cansol
Level by: Team BGA

"This is Team BGA's first collab level and it's so good that it won the ADOFAI Level of the Year Award in 2022! The team's hard work on this level's incredible visuals really paid off! But don't get distracted! This level's difficulty is a true test of skill!"

"This level won 3rd place for the ""Best Relaxing Level Award"" in LOTY 2022! If you're feeling stressed, Sharou's lofi beats might just help you relax! This level's equally chill gameplay will keep the vibes flowing, and the cute visuals will bring a smile to your face!"

Can’t it be true
Music by: Zris
Level by: Lycklig

“Can't it be true was made for the long-running, community-driven rhythm game music competition: "THE BMS OF FIGHTERS". The visuals for this particular level were inspired by the background animation made by ProjectG. Lycklig's creative use of decorations and track placement makes this level a unique gameplay experience!”


[h2]Game Features:[/h2]

- You can now open the Custom Level Select when you open ADOFAI without Steam. Just ensure that Steam is still running on your computer.
- We have a new Settings Menu UI!
- Level Selection with Number Keys on Extra Island, Crown Island, and Muse Dash Island
- Pure Perfect Only Mode: "Pure Perfect Mode" only allows Perfect hit margins and removes all checkpoints.
- Added 'Always' option to "Skip Long Intros"


[h2]Level Editor Features:[/h2]

- Pressing tab while selecting a property will now select the next one. Pressing ctrl + tab will select the previous one.
- Decorations now can be locked, making them not clickable from the world
- X and Y fields for Move Camera, Move Decoration, and Move Tile events can now be independently set
- Decoration Mask: You can remove an area or show an area using a decoration's shape. To use Decoration Mask, set "Mask type" option for the target decoration, and select either "Show Overlay" or "Hide Overlay." Then, add one more decoration and set "Mask Type" to "Mask Other Decoration."
- Parallax Offset: You can now move decorations without being affected by parallax value. 
- You can now customize the background of your tutorial levels
- You can now change default text and shadow color
- Decoration Blend Mode: You can mix decorations' colors from selecting an Image Decoration event and using Blend Mode. This is a little hard to explain, but you can watch an example here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UkUCysNfh60
- Editor First Floor Events: You couldn't add events to the first floor tile before, but now you can!
- Image decoration scaling and rotation now also works with UI gizmos.
- Edit Multiple Decorations: Select multiple decorations from the Decorations Tab to edit multiple decorations at once

- We have a few new keyboard shortcuts for the Editor, including…
- Lock/unlock all selected decorations -> Ctrl + L.
- Paste floors without decorations -> Ctrl + Alt + V
- Paste events without decorations or overwriting -> Ctrl + Shift + Alt + V
- Access the Editor Agreement -> Shift+F1


Thanks so much for playing!

Hello! We figured we'd surprise you with one more update for 2022. After this, we'll see you in the new year!

[h2]New World[/h2]

[b]World XI: It Go[/b] (Music by answearing machine, Level by Rikri, Character Design and Assets by Kyle, Animation and VFX by Firestix)

There's a few things we want to note about this world.
[olist]
[*]This is our first time working with our new VFX Artist, Firestix! You may know him from his many…cursed…works [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2161651144]in the Steam Workshop[/url]! Firestix went absolutely above and beyond with the animation in this new world, we're really excited for you to check it out.

[*]This world is very fast and difficult, intended for a hardcore audience. You can only find it on "Crown Island", the secret area where we've housed all of our most challenging levels. You can unlock Crown Island by beating the bonus level, "B-X: Thanks For Playing My Game." After that, a gemstone on the main menu will bring you to Crown Island. This is just a little treat for the subset of players who have conquered everything else the game has to offer. If that sounds like you, then we hope you enjoy the challenge!
[/olist]
Have fun!

[h2]Additions and Improvements[/h2]

You may have noticed that we're now experimenting with a "bulletin board" feature on the start-up screen of the game. The rooster sign will feature news related to the game before you navigate the main menu. Neat, right?

[h2]Happy Holidays and Happy New Year[/h2]

This is the final update you should expect to see from us in 2022! After taking a few weeks off for the holidays, we'll be back in 2023 to add more Featured Levels and small improvements. 

A Dance of Fire and Ice, the Neo Cosmos DLC, and Rhythm Doctor are all [b]on sale[/b] as part of the Steam Winter Sale. If you haven't tried all three before, now is a good time to pick them up. Likewise, if you have a friend who might enjoy rhythm games, let them know about the sale. Or surprise them with a gifted copy in their Steam inbox!

Thanks so much for playing, and for all the support in 2022. It really means a lot. We never knew that people would still be enjoying ADOFAI for this long, but the continued support on social media, the playthroughs on Youtube and Twitch, and over 15,000 community levels on Steam Workshop have all been so eye-opening for us. Thank you.

notes.title: Neo Cosmos OST and Future Content!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34150082/4f8a9d23654916979d586d86b97c899ef30041f9.png[/img]

It's been an exciting month!

In case you missed it: our DLC expansion, [b]Neo Cosmos[/b], is [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1977570/A_Dance_of_Fire_and_Ice__Neo_Cosmos/]out now![/url]

It's been two weeks since we've launched the DLC, and the reaction has been really amazing. Thank you all for your support and your feedback. We had been working on Neo Cosmos for a long time in secret, keeping most of the details to ourselves, and hoped that you would find it as fun and surprising as we did while playtesting. Thank you all so much for playing.

Here's a summary of everything new that's happened since then!

[h2]Version 2.0.3 (r92) Release Notes[/h2]

Warning: Gameplay spoilers for Neo Cosmos below!

We have some new [b]Accessibility Features.[/b] If you're having a hard time in Neo Cosmos, you can go to the Advanced Options section of the pause menu to tweak some settings.

[b]Hold Tiles:[/b] You can now choose from Normal (the usual default behavior), Allow Tapping Ending Tile (tap to end the hold, instead of releasing), and No Holding Required (just tap the beginning and ending tiles instead of holding.)

[b]Freeroam Tiles:[/b] You can now choose to be invulnerable during the Freeroam sections. With this enabled, you cannot be destroyed by touching spike balls or lasers.

[b]Custom Level Editor:[/b] Minor updates and changes to the editor

[b]Balance Changes:[/b] A few changes have been made to Neo Cosmos to make the experience more smooth for the player. In addition, Practice Mode is now available in T3, T3-EX, and T5

[b]New music by DM DOKURO:[/b] Our secret minigame now has a new song, by DM DOKURO!

[b]New Localization:[/b] ADOFAI and Neo Cosmos are both now available in French and German!

You can read the full list and description of changes in these patches by checking out our changelog here: https://7thbeat.notion.site/ADOFAI-Minor-Changelog-v2-0-1-r91-4c8da3f86f7c4039a9442dcd157cd30b

[h2]Neo Cosmos Soundtrack[/h2]

The official soundtrack for A Dance of Fire and Ice: Neo Cosmos is out now!

Find it on Steam:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2016420/A_Dance_of_Fire_and_Ice__Neo_Cosmos_OST/

Find it on Bandcamp: https://7thbeat.bandcamp.com/album/a-dance-of-fire-and-ice-neo-cosmos-ost

You can also listen to a few of the songs on our Youtube Channel: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLoV0Pc5bQC6LhGsbNaCGvHzuUP1TFeI1S

We couldn't have made Neo Cosmos without the help of our featured artists: Canblaster 2K6, Frums, Ash Astral, and DM DOKURO. They worked directly with TaroNuke in composing for the levels, and we really love the tracks they created.

If you'd like to support us and the featured artists, check it out!

[h2]We're Working On More Neo Cosmos Content[/h2]

We have three things we want to note quickly!

1. We are now working on adding more content to be added to the Neo Cosmos DLC! It will take a while, but please look forward to it. We were waiting to see what the reception of the DLC would be, and since so many people enjoyed it, we're happy to keep going and add more to it. These updates to Neo Cosmos will be free content patches.

2. As we announced before, we are going to continue adding to the base game. That means new worlds, new Level Editor tweaks and improvements, new accessibility features, etc. are being worked on for regular A Dance of Fire and Ice as free content patches.

3. We're making a minor price change to the Neo Cosmos DLC. After receiving a lot of really positive feedback from players, and surprise at its price, we have decided to raise the price by $1 USD. If you already own the DLC, this doesn't affect you at all! You don't have to pay anything extra. Thank you for supporting the DLC so early. Consider the earlier price just a "super Launch Discount!"

The sales of Neo Cosmos have allowed us to dedicate the time to adding new stuff to it in the future, so we're really grateful for your support and your interest. There's more to come!


That's all for now! Thanks for playing, and check out the Neo Cosmos Soundtrack if you want to take the songs with you everywhere you go!

Our fans run a Discord server where you can talk about our games and the level editor: discord.gg/rhythmdr

notes.content:

[h2]DLC Features[/h2]

[b]New editor features:[/b] New Neo Cosmos-specific level events added to the Level Editor. Share your levels on Steam Workshop, and play levels that use them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34150082/420223317904fb0387876a875ffa320ded90b6d2.gif[/img]

[h2]Neo Cosmos FAQ[/h2]

[b]Q: Who made Neo Cosmos?[/b]
A: Neo Cosmos is directed by TaroNuke, with help from the 7th Beat Games team. We all worked on it together, but it deserves a huge thank-you to Taro for coming up with the ideas, story, and levels. Thank you Taro! It also includes great character art from two artists, SUPERCOMPUTATION and electr1ca.

[b]Q: How difficult is Neo Cosmos?[/b]
A: It has some new surprises, so that answer will be different for each player! We recommend that you at least try playing the main 12 Worlds of A Dance of Fire and Ice before playing Neo Cosmos. We like how it feels as an extension after playing those, but the DLC does not require that you beat those levels to play it, so don't worry!

[b]Q: Do I need to unlock Neo Cosmos?[/b]
A: If you've purchased the Neo Cosmos DLC, the only thing you need to do to unlock the new content is to complete World 1 (and the boss level 1-X) from the beginning of the game. You probably have it unlocked already!

[b]Q: Is the Neo Cosmos DLC needed to play Steam Workshop levels that use special Neo Cosmos Level Editor events?[/b]
A: Yes, owning the Neo Cosmos DLC is required to create or play custom levels that use the new Neo Cosmos Level Editor events.

[b]Q: Will the Neo Cosmos content come to mobile?[/b]
A: Yes, eventually! We are still working on it, so it might take a while for the mobile version to be updated. We can't really confirm anything else about the mobile version yet. Thank you for understanding!

[b]Q: Will A Dance of Fire and Ice, the base game, still receive free updates?[/b]
A: Yes! The base game will be treated separately, and will still receive free updates, such as levels and level editor improvements.

[b]Q: Us the Neo Cosmos soundtrack available to purchase?[/b]
A: Yes! You can get the soundtrack on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2016420/A_Dance_of_Fire_and_Ice__Neo_Cosmos_OST/]Steam[/url] or [url=https://7thbeat.bandcamp.com/album/a-dance-of-fire-and-ice-neo-cosmos-ost]Bandcamp![/url]

Ever since we launched A Dance of Fire and Ice, we've been surprised over and over again with how many different ways there are for creators to explore new rhythms and new game concepts. The game has evolved a lot since it first launched.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34150082/c39aaa3401d26308aaa4c52af7244923a53ae7cf.png[/img]

[h1]Version 1.15.0 release notes[/h1]

[h2]3-Year Anniversary Update[/h2]

It’s hard for us to believe that it’s already the 3rd Anniversary of launching A Dance of Fire and Ice on Steam, but here we are. Time has flown by, and we continue to be surprised and honored by the positive feedback we’ve seen from players about our simple rhythm game. We really appreciate everyone who has played the game, whether you’ve mastered the skills on your own, shared your scores with friends, or streamed yourself marathoning 6-X until you finally got it right.

To celebrate the 3-Year Anniversary, we’ve got a few additions to the game this week!

Here's our [url=https://7thbeat.notion.site/ADOFAI-Changelog-v1-15-r78-99885586c6d042f9a87e1821cdd821c8]full changelog[/url] if you prefer not to miss every single detail.

[h2]Collaboration with “Rhythm Journey”[/h2]

New World: [b]Fear Grows[/b], with music by Linky

Recently we became fans of a new indie rhythm game, [b]Rhythm Journey[/b]. It's a game inspired by ADOFAI on the surface (with tutorial levels for each song, speed trials, one-hit death etc), but actually tackles a different aspect of rhythm theory! It's focused on teaching you different kick and snare rhythms on the drums, so it uses two buttons instead of one. Each song is written to teach you a unique rhythm, from ghost notes to swing notes to fun drum fills. We at 7th Beat Games are all about unique rhythm mechanics so we love it. Not enough people are playing this game, so now we're doing a collab so that more of you will check it out. The new world, RJ, has a special one-time gimmick that's a nod to their game's mechanic, guess what it is…

Thanks to Linky, the musician of Rhythm Journey for supplying the song and also making all the tutorial tracks! And check their game out for their part of the collab, featuring their interpretation of ADOFAI's title track!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1945220/
iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/rhythm-journey/id1602799241
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.melovity.rhythmjourney/

[h2]New Options: “Practice” and “No Fail” Modes[/h2]

We’re introduced two new options for helping players learn levels they’re stuck on.

Practice Mode: With the Practice Mode option toggled on, you can practice a segment of a level that you’ve failed on. After you lose, press the P key before respawning to trigger Practice Mode. This will give you a chance to practice the segment of the song that you’re stuck on. You can exit Practice Mode in the Pause Menu. This feature can be used on both official levels and custom community levels.

No Fail Mode: No Fail Mode is an option you can use while playing custom community levels. This “No Fail” option allows you to continue to the next tile even if you miss it, and it disables Overloading. When you finish the level, the Results Screen will display info about your misses if you have the “Detailed Results” option toggled on. In a way, it’s like playing the custom level with Invincibility. We hope this is useful for learning really difficult custom levels, or having the option to enjoy the full song even if you cannot complete the level on your own.

You can enable “No Fail” mode in the Custom Level Editor by clicking the armor icon in the bottom right corner. You can also toggle it in the Custom Level Select menu by pressing the N key. An icon will display in the corner while you play, indicating that you are playing with “No Fail” mode on.

[h2]New: Featured Levels[/h2]

In the years since the game’s launch onto Steam, we have seen really incredible work done by the community with the custom level editor. Knowing that some players might not search through Steam Workshop to find these creations, we decided we wanted to find a way to highlight them and add them to the game for everyone to enjoy. We reached out to the original musicians and the level creators and will now begin adding a few of our favorites to the game! This way, even users who don’t search through Steam Workshop can easily find these levels we enjoyed.

You can now find these levels by heading to the Custom Level Select and entering the “Featured Levels” section. We will update this section with more levels periodically throughout the year, so you will hear from us again on more favorites we’ve been playing.

Nichipe will be joining us in handling the search and curation for custom Featured Levels. He has played over a thousand ADOFAI levels, and has a [url=https://www.youtube.com/c/Nichipe/videos]great Youtube channel[/url] where he tries out and discusses great levels each year, so working together has been a natural fit. Thank you, Nichipe!

We also plan to add these levels to the iOS and Android versions of A Dance of Fire and Ice in the future, allowing mobile players to also enjoy them.

Our first few Featured Levels are:

[b]Final Phase[/b], music by Plum, level design by Daming

[b]Barrage[/b], music by Halv, level design by NumbEr07

[b]Make It Funky Now[/b], music by DOT96, level design by PizzaLovers007

[h2]Coming Soon: Neo Cosmos[/h2]

In case you missed it, we’re working on an expansion to A Dance of Fire and Ice! It’s called [b]Neo Cosmos[/b], and it’s directed by TaroNuke, creator of [url=https://notitg.heysora.net/]NotITG[/url] and UKSRT! It features a new set of levels, and a few gameplay surprises. We’re still working hard on it, but we do have a teaser to share…

[previewyoutube=fMwmiGOxSh0;full][/previewyoutube]

Neo Cosmos will be a paid DLC, but free updates will continue to be added to the base game A Dance of Fire and Ice even after it’s out.

Thanks for playing, and thanks for all the incredible feedback on Steam, Twitter, and Discord over the past three years. We still have more plans for A Dance of Fire and Ice, and we’re excited to keep working on them. Thank you for coming on this journey with us!

notes.title: Steam Workshop Support Added!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34150082/bbf0cdb55d205835b41d71b11e8425334a1c1c3b.png[/img]

[h1]Version 1.11.0 release notes[/h1]

Steam Workshop support is here! 

Visit our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/977950/workshop/]Workshop[/url] to easily browse custom levels made by the community. Download a level you’d like to play by clicking the green “Subscribe” button, then the level will appear in the Custom Level Select section of the game’s main menu. If you’re looking for some great levels to start with, try the levels that rank high in the “Most Subscribed” tab or levels tagged with the “Easy” or “Medium” difficulty.

Another great place to start is to download the levels from the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2130405281]RDL Constellations[/url] collection, which is a set of levels recommended by the moderator staff on our Discord Server.

A new Xtra level, ‘[b]Rose Garden[/b]’, has been added! The song is by [url=https://soundcloud.com/youtube-rody-code]RoDy.cOde[/url], and the level is created by hotduck, LUMI, and NumbEr07. Test your skills with sharp triangle turns in an elegant floating garden.

New difficult levels have been added in a new location, Crown Island, with:

‘[b]One Forgotten Night[/b]’, with music by [url=https://soundcloud.com/quree2357]Quree[/url] and level design by Star4th.
‘[b]Options[/b]’, with music by [url=https://soundcloud.com/frums]Frums[/url]. This level was inspired by a level created by PowerFactory.

[b]New features:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Steam Workshop + Custom Level Select[/b]: Access the Custom Level Select in the main menu to play custom levels. You can browse through all of the levels you have subscribed to on our Steam Workshop page.
[*][b]Adjustments of default timing strictness for levels faster than 310 bpm. [/b]
In ADOFAI, timing strictness is determined by the angles the planets make to the tiles, so the game becomes stricter as the planets move faster. This used to happen up to a cap of 500 bpm. After the cap, the timing doesn’t get more strict. From this version onwards, the cap is now 310 bpm in ‘Normal mode’, and 500 bpm in ‘Strict mode’.
[*][b]Timing strictness option for fast levels:[/b]
You can now change the timing strictness upon starting the level, if the level is above 310 bpm.
‘Normal’ strictness will make any speeds above 310bpm have the same timing strictness as what it is at 310 bpm. ‘Strict’ timing strictness raises that cap to 500 bpm.
This change doesn’t affect the difficulty of any past official levels, since all official levels in the game so far have been below 310 bpm.
This change was done to enable more players to be able to experience faster custom levels. Experienced players can still use Strict mode to use the old timing strictness. Strictness is indicated in the bottom right of the screen.
(The ‘Red Otto’ symbol seen in the bottom-right corner of the screen in the previous versions of the game is the equivalent of Strict mode in the new version.)
[*][b]New Shortcuts:[/b] From the Level Select screen, press Ctrl+Shift+E (Command+Shift+E on Mac) to open the Level Editor and Ctrl+Shift+C (Command+Shift+C on Mac) to open the Custom Level Select screen.
[*][b]Crown Island:[/b] If you’re looking for an even harder challenge, a new post-game set of levels will be unlocked for those who complete the bonus level B-X.
[*]The planets now have a sound effect when they explode. More sound effects coming soon, from our new sound designer s9menine! If you'd like to disable it, press Ctrl-Shift-D during a level or in the level select.
[*][b]Multiple hits:[/b] multiple keypresses in a single frame are now properly detected as multiple inputs, rather than the extra keypresses being dropped, so you no longer have to stagger your inputs when there are hits very close to each other. These are only allowed for singular double-hits, not on long consecutive hits, so that you still can’t cheese them by playing them at half-speed with two keys per hit, e.g. 123412341234 being played as [12][34][12][34].
[/list]

[b]New editor features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Editor Position Offset indicator lines now have an animated dotted line that indicates the direction of the connection
[*]Editor Floor Number markings (Ctrl+F on Windows, Command+F on Mac) and Position Offset line indicators now respawn on exiting the editor playback mode
[*]Color Picker: You can now set the color properties in the Editor by using a Color Picker to set the color. No more Hex Codes needed!
[*]Planet Decorations: Set decorations to be anchored to the movement of the planets themselves, so that the decorations will travel with them.
[/list]

We are excited to see and play the worlds you come up with and add to our Workshop community! If you’re interested in publishing your level to the Steam Workshop, please read this guide to make sure your song has verified permission and that there are no issues with the level: [url=https://www.notion.so/7BG-Guidelines-278aa02ea60c41549641e75c0b69ba34]https://www.notion.so/7BG-Guidelines-278aa02ea60c41549641e75c0b69ba34[/url]

notes.title: Rhythm Doctor - Steam Game Festival Demo
notes.content:
As you may know, we have another rhythm game in development called Rhythm Doctor. In conjunction with the Steam Game Festival, we're releasing a limited-time sneak peek of a few of Rhythm Doctor's levels. If you enjoyed A Dance of Fire and Ice, we highly suggest you check it out!

You can find the game at its [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/774181/Rhythm_Doctor/]Steam Store Page[/url], and find the Festival demo [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/gamefestival]here.[/url]

[h2]What is Rhythm Doctor?[/h2]
Rhythm Doctor is a one-button rhythm game where you heal patients in a hospital by synchronising shocks to their heartbeats. Each patient has a unique heartbeat to sync to. Inspired by the Rhythm Heaven series, the game focuses on simple-looking rhythms and then tries to catch you off-guard, throwing fiendish tricks to throw you off-rhythm!

[h2]What's in the Demo[/h2]
[list]
[*]Four levels from the full game, each one with unique tricks to throw you off-rhythm
[*]A Sleeve Painter tool for you to draw your own personal sleeve and express yourself in freehand
[*]A new guided calibration tool to ensure the game is accurate for your setup
[*]The latest version of our level editor
[*]Some secrets for the determined
[*]If you have a friend, every level can be played in local two-player mode
[*]Each level is perfectly synced (we're musicians and off-beat games hurt us)
[/list]
[h2]Frequently Asked Questions[/h2]
[h3]I want more![/h3]
Have you played the [url=https://fizzd.itch.io/rhythm-doctor]original flash demo[/url] from years ago? The levels there are totally different from the newer ones in the Steam demo, but we think they're still pretty good!

[h3]Simple?! These levels were really difficult![/h3]
We wanted to give a taste of levels from the easy to the hard end. Rest assured that the full game has many levels in between these to slowly train up your defibrillation skills.

[h3]You've been making this game for 1343 years.[/h3]
Yes...

[h2]Thanks for playing![/h2]
Thanks for checking us out. If you liked the demo, you can wishlist the game to be notified when we release. If you have bug reports, questions or feedback, we're real active on the [url=discord.gg/rhythmdr]Rhythm Doctor Discord[/url]. Come and say hi!

[/list]

New level editor features:
[list]
[*]New custom background options: Now you can make custom backgrounds loop, or even have a parallax effect! Set backgrounds to tiled for funky repeating patterns, or set them to unscaled and set the size of the background yourself, allowing you to make sprawling landscapes that you can explore throughout your level!
[*]Camera settings: Now you can set the camera at the very start of the level! Want a cinematic angle right off the bat for your favorite action movie song? Well go ahead and make it a reality!
[*]Color and animate track events: The Change Track event has been replaced with two new events: Color Track and Animate Track. You’ll be able to do the same things you’ve always been able to do with the original Change Track event, but now you don’t have to worry about managing a single gargantuan event each time!
[*]New track color options: Now you can add a pulse effect to animated track color types (glow, etc.), letting you make cool waves of color that move throughout your level. Speaking of animated track color types, there’s now a few more you can play around with; Blink and Switch color types will give you plenty to experiment with! Tip: Set pulse length to 2 for a fun disco pattern!
[*]Recolor track event: Introducing Recolor Track! This will allow you to change the color - and even the style - of a section of track, right in the middle of your level! Now you can do cool effects, like changing the color of the whole track to fit the mood at different points in a song, among other things. See what cool things you can come up with!
[*]Set filter event: Introducing Set Filter! This lets you add all kinds of cool filters to your level. Make the game look like it’s on an old 80’s TV, or like it’s on an arcade machine, or add some rain, or even make it look like a pencil drawing! You can even add several filters at once! VHS recording in a blizzard? Yep!
[*]Hall of mirrors events: Introducing Hall of Mirrors! Have you ever won Windows Solitaire? Well add a little of that fun card-snake magic to your level! It might look a bit weird on its own, but try combining it with background flashes, or even some filters!
[*]Shortcuts panel: Don’t know how to use the fancy keyboard shortcuts needed to use some of the editor’s features? Just press ctrl + H - or click “Help” in the file actions panel, to get a handy little panel telling you all the shortcuts you’ll need to know. Now you’re creating with power!
[/list]

[*]Editor: fixed possible desync when starting in the middle of a level (thanks Nichipe!)

[*]Midnight Train can keep up with the planets during Speed Trials

notes.title: A Dance of Fire and Ice Launches on January 25
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34150082/5e2567416e8eb65232117ed5813d75bde0777495.png[/img]

A Dance of Fire and Ice is a simple one-button rhythm game.

Press on every beat of the music to move in a line.

Every pattern has its own rhythm to it. It can get difficult. This game is purely based on rhythm, so use your ears more than your sight.

Note that it is quite strict and unforgiving, so please play the online version here if you're not sure if this is for you! If you've played the Rhythm Heaven series - this is about as strict as that.

[list]
[*] Explore the cosmos: Soar through each genre of music in a variety of colorful fantasy landscapes.	
[*] Predict every moment: With a track that shows you every rhythm ahead of time, you’ll learn to sight-read levels as they come. No tricks, and nothing is reaction-based.
[*] Play new levels for free: Tackle new songs and new rhythms as we expand the game with free level patches over the coming months.
[*] Calibrate your experience: Manually adjust your calibration on-the-fly, or use our auto-calibration method. The game is precisely timed, and you won’t experience any slow desync over time like you might with other music-based twitch games. (We’re musicians and off-sync games hurt us.)
[/list]
